known_issues: Tapping a notification opens a Google search for the username instead of navigating to the user's profile

existing_features.title: Fix the notification item tap/click handler in the Notifications page so that tapping a notification navigates to the referenced user's in-app profile page instead of triggering a Google search for the username. The navigation must use the app's internal router (e.g., TanStack Router) to route to the correct profile route, and must not construct any external URL or href that would open a browser search.

projectName: Fix notification tap navigating to Google search instead of user profile
